name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after JTAC raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 (MI5). No change had been announced as of 7 Nov.
for_you: Follow MI5 and police guidance to stay alert in crowded places and report anything suspicious.
why: The official MI5 assessment of the likelihood of a terrorist attack in the UK.
